insights.one_liner: Major Dutch telecom and internet provider, an IND recognised sponsor, with an English-language data role in its AI-driven network unit.

culture.text: Dutch telecom company aiming to securely connect everyone in the Netherlands; its Network Services unit works on AI towards a fully autonomous network.
Large employer, with about 18,949 staff in 2013, and headquarters listed in The Hague and Rotterdam.
Its open data and AI job is based in Amsterdam and shows the salary.

open.text: KPN is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open Amsterdam data role needs no Dutch.

growth.text: Launched Mobiel AI, with call summaries for small businesses.

worth_knowing.text: Reshuffled its top team: Wouter Stammeijer becomes CFO from 1 November 2026 and Cibic becomes CTO.
Also announced changes to its Board of Management and Supervisory Board for its next strategy phase.
